title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^122.224

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.3912, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.224 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.223379. Relation collection keeps the accepted frontier's 2601/2500 work and 2401/2500 yield brackets; its f-side ECM cofactor slack is 289 bits (surviving f-side cofactors bounded by 297) and its g-side slack is 219 bits (surviving g-side cofactors bounded by 227) at the same five-limb ECM cost, giving retained yield 2^64.1922, which is 0.362 bits above 1.3 U and above the model's 0.30-bit feasibility floor. The descent's missing-log input is LOG2_RELS = 64.192, the floor of that same model count (the 2401/2500 yield bracket is already included); evidence16.py checks LOG2_RELS <= log2_rels (the rels_input check), fixing the input mismatch of rejected submission 97b80666. The metered descent cap is 2^118.9255 units, above the same plan's two-log expectation 2^118.180 (Markov abort <= 2^-0.745, exact 2^-0.74500066). The certified norm-bound per-block charge is the measured marginal 1,508.2 instructions (measurements12.txt) instead of the cushioned 1,550; linear algebra uses block sizes (26,5), per-entry charges 88/97 (the package's 88-instruction component sum and the measured 97-instruction bw_full loop, replacing the cushioned 90/100), and the filtering/LA pad 1.61, whose charged ratio 1.61 x 0.0471 = 0.07585 still exceeds the worst measured 2^12 filtering seed ratio 0.0757. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.224 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
